description: One regime tag on one record. The child table behind the Table MultiSelect on Compliance Alert.regime and Training Type.regimes — one shape of row, two parents, exactly as Farm Task Evidence is one shape of row on four. It carries nothing but the link on purpose: anything else on it would be a fact about the regime, which belongs on Compliance Regime, or a fact about the record, which belongs on the record.
